commands:
echo "RUN_ID=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-unset} ATTEMPT=${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-unset}"
git status --porcelain
echo "---base---"
/home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/scripts/config-get.sh .base_branch main 2>&1
echo "---pr view---"
gh pr view 1106 --json headRefName,baseRefName,baseRefOid,headRefOid,title,body --jq '{head:.headRefName,base:.baseRefName,baseOid:.baseRefOid,headOid:.headRefOid,title:.title}' 2>&1

ls .changeset/ | head; echo "---sample---"; for f in $(git show origin/main:.changeset 2>/dev/null | tail -n +3); do git show origin/main:.changeset/$f 2>/dev/null | head -6; echo "=== $f ==="; done 2>/dev/null | head -40

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
